items.item: (2) 'C ranks it above' and 'C's ranking' where the theorem takes Comparison
items.how: I opened the Lean first. Ranking.restraint_ranks_stepwise (JointDraw.lean:250) and Ranking.whole_run_ranks (Ranking.lean:409) take ComparisonUnder, which is Comparison with living := True. RenewalComparison.overdraw_comparison_ranks (deeper/RenewalComparison.lean:160) takes ComparisonPrinciple. event_comparison_ranks_rest_below (RenewingFormation.lean:610) proves a GenerativeExtension. Ranking.restraint_extends_iff_relational gives only the extension, and the ranking then follows from C's definition. Web.extension_met_keeps_above_ending is at FromTheDynamics.lean:179. Edits: relation-level-law-of-easing statement now ends 'and every order meeting C ranks it above' (en at 300 of the 300 cap: 'Read by relation', 'what the easing course no longer takes part in', 'letting no level fall and still taking part'). stepwise-law-of-easing statement does the same (300: 'withdraws exactly what the easing course undermines; one whose levels never fall undermines none'), and so does its related[0]. ranking-under-readings: the title is now 'What every order meeting C ranks under each reading' / 满足 C 的每种次序在各读法下的排序, with the old titles kept as aliases. Its statement (300) is now 'Stepwise, every order meeting C ranks sharing above winning by consumption and restraint above overdraw, but need not rank absence above an overdrawer included before the loss; on the possibility reading, all three' (law 6). The English first sentence dropped 'under either living reading' to fit the cap, and the Chinese keeps it. related[2] and [3] and the interface output are changed too. relational-reading-comparison: statement ('every order meeting C ranks it strictly higher; read event by event, C asks nothing of the two'), laws[3], does_not_show[4] and related[1]. renewing-consuming-formation: counterexamples[2] (the extension is the theorem, and every order meeting C ranks the rest below) and related[5]. living-on-and-descent related[1]: 'What C asks an order to rank varies with the reading'. graded-significance-and-priority statement and does_not_show[1]: 'mixed transfers, of which C asks nothing'. joint-difference-making related[1]. route-b-joined laws[3]: 'the pair the met-pair C asks an order to rank'. route-b-joined laws[4]: 'never asks a ranking of the course taken'. All caps met, with no new lint warning. Kept as exact: protection-priority ('every natural-number score satisfying C ranks') and what-a-course-keeps-reachable ('a verdict C leaves open'). route-b-joined's statement 'orders … give C only along what they show' is kept as J1's wording.

alignment-direction-under-widening progress[0]: 'E covers evidential adequacy and the grounds for its classifications, undertakings and authority', as its hypothesis 2 says. reserved-shutdown-during-recovery related[0]: 'still needs its own argument within the account' (zh 仍需在本论之内另有其论证). wisdom-root dependencies[24] interface conditions: 'without deriving the original reading's actual adequacy or an argument for adopting it'. continuation-condition-yields-living-significance needed nothing: its does_not_show[1] already reads 'The continuation condition itself is not proved here; the theorems take it as a hypothesis' (an earlier pass). I also changed three normative uses the search found. organizational-formation-from-generative-comparison statement: 'can warrant building' became 'can support building' (as its Chinese 可支持 already says). Its hypotheses[1]: 'eligibility and the basic classifications are supplied, each needing its own argument'. classification-robust-generative-comparison hypotheses[3]: 'an arbitrary assignment is not presumed to classify actual lives as they are'. Its region note: 'conditional support'. Kept as evidential or conditional senses: warranted bounds, translations, claims and laws; certificates that warrant; 'the warrant it gives is the construction's under the practical commitments'; 'E includes warrant for basic classifications'; and registry.py's page footer 'establish premise warrant' (whether premises hold).

They now say 'under the condition and J1–J4, comparing by widening' (related: 'under the continuation condition and J1–J4, moves compared by widening'). The atlas dynamics entry that quotes it (dynamics.json [33].open[3]) changed with it. This follows Direction.lean: every theorem takes Priority, extension_iff_widens is at line 90, and Priority.comparison is at FrontierFrames.lean:445. alignment-direction-under-widening hypotheses[0] and alignment-approaches does_not_show[1] and related[9] already say this from pass 7, and progress[2] is dated and kept (E10). alignment-approaches related[10] said 'What C asks: the order every order increasing in admission shares' (C as an order). It now reads widening as its record states it: 'Widening, by which C asks an order to rank: on a finite listing, what every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero, and every order of a class holding these, ranks higher' (H1, H5). No other record lists C among the direction's or the handover's hypotheses.

items.item: (5) H16 (b) one-center sentences and H16 (a) where relations close
items.how: the-continuation-condition-on-the-root is the ch07 agent's (in its changed list). I read it: its law already says 'Along a net with no cycle, where the condition holds, every standpoint has the same center' (H6), and no gloss by dated occurrences is left, so I did not touch it. the-own-class-read-on-a-flow correspondence is now exact, as 07 §4.10 says it: 'Along dated occurrences, a net going forward in time and so without cycles, the line is the occurrence alone («无环则返之所及唯己»)'. That is another law, not the one-center result. Kept as exact: significance-retained-within-margin laws[14] ('On an acyclic relation the condition forces every center to coincide', with the condition as subject) and J3's what-the-one-center-bound-counts. H16 (a): self-concern-through-dependence related[0] now says 'read across all steps' with the in-time limit (the-condition-in-time). mutual-dependence-and-its-pace statement (297 of 300) now says 'read across all steps'. A new does_not_show item says that read in time the condition holds only from some step on, exactly where the flow is mutually dependent in time, and that this can lapse. Region notes changed: mutual-dependence-gives-the-condition-de-se ('read across all steps'). the-condition-in-time is now J3's corrected wording: fails over every step, holds from some step on exactly where mutually dependent in time, and over every later step exactly where each affects every other at the next. PersistingChoices module ('under mutual dependence read across all steps'). route-b-joined: in place of 'C read from what persisting shows' it says 'what orders allowed by a persisting line's choices give of C'. self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition: 'with admission decided … admitted pairs fit in a finite list', with no 'one way'.

The Chinese no longer has 单向 and says 自我关切的次序 … 并在容纳已判定时. The chapter-07 register row (arguments-a-l [19]) is re-said the same way in both languages. generativity-chain M21 claim: 'under C or a premise in its place' (the withdrawn frame) became 'under the hypotheses its theorem takes, such as self-concern where the condition holds, or C', in both languages. C26 scope (F5): 'Universal zero-substantive-axiom warrant remains open' became 'was left open here (on 9 November 2026 set aside as a question the map does not need; C20)'.

items.item: The edge record's order premise (one-root-to-its-edge), H12, H14, H15
items.how: The name now says C with its reading of living: 'the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it extends by a claim counted as living (with every claim counted, above every course it widens; where the condition holds de se, self-concern does what it asks on a finite listing and, with admission decided, between level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list)', with the Chinese the same. The basis defines self-concern and its reach. It drops 'one way', and in place of 'for courses that go on forming without end it is not shown' it says 'under chapter 7's activity, support and descent hypotheses, the course of a line that persists without end never fits such a list, so there this route is silent' (Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted). test_boundary's live-premises test now also asserts no 'one way', 'go on forming without end', 'an order holding one's own continuation' or 单向, and asserts 'counted as living', 'admission decided' and 'never fits such a list'.

The one exception is alignment-direction-under-widening progress[0], which was already over its 240-character warning cap and is now 307. All JSON parses and each file keeps its own format. Proposed: '**C asks no ranking of the course taken.** … so what C asks between listed level paths concerns only alternatives the line did not take'. FromTheDynamics.lean:175's docstring ('the met-pair C ranks only keeping above ending') is for a later Lean pass.

Its one-center law is in the H6 form, but it does not carry H16 (b)'s time clause (on a net going forward in time this comes from the condition's asking that nothing other than the center lie at or before the center's step; over what comes after two centers can meet it). Its related list has only reach-past-ones-own-end. A related link to what-the-one-center-bound-counts would carry the clause. That is its owner's call.
